brief:
Bank of Palestine distributed school bags to students in Gaza City, Deir al-Balah, and Khan Younis, according to the Maan news agency. The initiative aimed to support students as the academic year progressed in the besieged territory.

The bank's effort comes amid ongoing humanitarian challenges affecting Palestinian civilians in Gaza, where access to educational supplies remains constrained by the territory's economic conditions and blockade.
title: Palestinian bank distributes school bags across Gaza districts
